mapper.select: SELECT u.user_num, u.user_name FROM team_member tm JOIN users u ON tm.user_num = u.user_num WHERE tm.team_num = #{team_num} AND tm.join_status = 1 ORDER BY u.user_name
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_KANBAN_CARD.nextval FROM dual
INSERT INTO kanban_card( card_num, team_num, writer_num, title, content, tag, tag_color, deadline, filename ) VALUES ( #{card_num}, #{team_num}, #{writer_num}, #{title}, #{content}, #{tag}, #{tag_color}, #{deadline}, #{filename,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT tag, CASE WHEN tag = '기타' THEN '#8b95a5' ELSE MIN(tag_color) END AS tag_color FROM ( SELECT NVL(TRIM(tag), '기타') AS tag, NVL(tag_color, '#6c5ce7') AS tag_color FROM kanban_card WHERE team_num = #{team_num} AND status != 2 ) GROUP BY tag ORDER BY CASE WHEN tag = '기타' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tag
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kanban_assign ( assignee_num, team_num, card_num, user_num ) VALUES ( SEQ_KANBAN_ASSIGN.nextval, #{team_num}, #{card_num}, #{user_num} )
mapper.select:
SELECT kc.card_num, kc.team_num, kc.writer_num, u.user_name AS writer_name, kc.title, kc.content, kc.tag, kc.tag_color, kc.kanban_status, kc.deadline, kc.reg_date, kc.modify_date, kc.status FROM kanban_card kc JOIN users u ON kc.writer_num = u.user_num WHERE kc.team_num = #{team_num} AND kc.status != 2
AND NVL(TRIM(kc.tag), '기타') = #{tag}
AND ( kc.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR kc.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND ( kc.writer_num = #{user_num} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kanban_assign ka WHERE ka.card_num = kc.card_num AND ka.user_num = #{user_num} ) )
ORDER BY kc.kanban_status ASC, kc.card_num DESC
SELECT ka.assignee_num, ka.team_num, ka.card_num, ka.user_num, u.user_name FROM kanban_assign ka JOIN users u ON ka.user_num = u.user_num WHERE ka.card_num = #{card_num} ORDER BY u.user_name

SELECT kc.card_num, kc.team_num, kc.writer_num, u.user_name AS writer_name, kc.title, kc.content, kc.tag, kc.tag_color, kc.kanban_status, kc.deadline, kc.filename, cf.file_num, cf.origin_name, kc.reg_date, kc.modify_date, kc.status FROM kanban_card kc JOIN users u ON kc.writer_num = u.user_num LEFT JOIN chat_file cf ON cf.save_name = kc.filename AND cf.team_num = kc.team_num WHERE kc.card_num = #{card_num} AND kc.team_num = #{team_num} AND kc.status != 2
mapper.update: UPDATE kanban_card SET kanban_status=#{kanban_status}, modify_date=SYSDATE WHERE card_num=#{card_num} AND team_num=#{team_num} AND status!=2

UPDATE kanban_card SET title=#{title}, content=#{content}, tag=#{tag}, tag_color=#{tag_color}, deadline=#{deadline}, filename=#{filename}, modify_date=SYSDATE WHERE card_num=#{card_num} AND team_num=#{team_num} AND status!=2
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_num, c.card_num, c.user_num, c.content, c.reg_date, c.modify_date, c.status, u.user_name FROM kanban_comment c JOIN users u ON c.user_num = u.user_num WHERE c.card_num = #{card_num} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.comment_num DESC
